issuing_authority: Internal — aligned to CBUAE AML/CFT Regulations for Banks and FATF Recommendation 10
framework_overview: Risk-based approach (RBA) classifying retail customers into Low, Medium, or High risk based on customer, geography, product, and channel risk factors. High-risk customers require Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) and senior compliance officer sign-off before onboarding.

LOW.description: Standard customer due diligence sufficient. Auto-approve eligible if all gates pass.

MEDIUM.description: Standard CDD plus mandatory compliance officer review. May require additional documentation.
MEDIUM.monitoring: Enhanced transaction monitoring on first 6 months

HIGH.description: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) mandatory. Senior compliance officer sign-off required. Source of funds/wealth documentation mandatory.

customer.name: Politically Exposed Person (PEP)
customer.description: Customer is, or is closely associated with, a domestic PEP, foreign PEP, or international organisation PEP per CBUAE definitions.

customer.name: Undisclosed PEP status
customer.description: Customer failed to self-declare PEP status that is confirmed by external screening. Material misrepresentation.

customer.name: Adverse media — financial crime
customer.description: Credible adverse media linking customer to money laundering, fraud, corruption, or terrorist financing.

customer.name: Adverse media — non-financial serious crime
customer.description: Credible adverse media linking customer to serious non-financial crime.

customer.name: Sanctions match — confirmed
customer.description: Customer is a confirmed match against UN, OFAC, EU, UK HMT, or UAE consolidated sanctions lists. Onboarding prohibited; mandatory STR filing.

customer.name: Sanctions match — possible but not confirmed
customer.description: Plausible match on sanctions lists pending disambiguation. Hold and EDD.

geography.name: FATF black-list jurisdiction
geography.description: Nationality, residency, or material source-country is a FATF-listed High-Risk Jurisdiction subject to a Call for Action (DPRK, Iran).

geography.name: FATF grey-list jurisdiction
geography.description: Nationality, residency, or material source-country is on the FATF list of Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring.

geography.name: Sanctioned jurisdiction nexus
geography.description: Material connection to a comprehensively sanctioned jurisdiction (e.g. Russia, Syria, certain regions). Includes nationality and primary source of funds.

geography.name: Standard low-risk jurisdiction
geography.description: Nationality and source-country are FATF-compliant low-risk jurisdictions.

occupation_industry.name: Cash-intensive business
occupation_industry.description: Customer occupation/industry typically involves high cash volumes (e.g. money exchange, jewellery trade, used car dealer).

occupation_industry.name: Virtual asset / crypto trader
occupation_industry.description: Self-declared crypto trader, VASP operator, or material income from virtual assets.

occupation_industry.name: Standard salaried occupation
occupation_industry.description: Salaried employment with verifiable employer; standard low-risk occupation.

occupation_industry.name: Independent investor / trader with no verifiable employer
occupation_industry.description: Self-employed in financial markets without verifiable counterparty or institutional record.

document_integrity.name: Identity document mismatch
document_integrity.description: Name, DOB, or nationality differs materially between the application form, ID document, and proof of address.

document_integrity.name: Minor transliteration variation
document_integrity.description: Spelling variation explainable by Arabic-to-English transliteration (e.g. Mohammed / Mohammad) and other identifiers align.

document_integrity.name: Address mismatch on PoA
document_integrity.description: Proof of address lists a different address than the application form. Requires updated PoA or reconciliation.

product_channel.name: Standard retail current account
product_channel.description: Standard retail product through standard channel.

product_channel.name: Wealth onboarding tier
product_channel.description: Customer onboarded into private banking / wealth tier — EDD threshold lower.

decision_matrix.PROHIBITED_present: Any single PROHIBITED factor → REJECT (e.g. confirmed sanctions match, FATF black-list nationality).
decision_matrix.HIGH_present: Any single HIGH factor → REFER to compliance for EDD (e.g. PEP, possible sanctions, sanctioned jurisdiction nexus, identity mismatch).
decision_matrix.two_or_more_MEDIUM: Two or more MEDIUM factors → REFER to compliance.
decision_matrix.single_MEDIUM: Single MEDIUM factor → REFER unless mitigated; medium-risk classification.
decision_matrix.all_LOW_or_none: All factors LOW or absent → APPROVE under standard CDD.

edd_requirements_if_referred: Documented source of funds and source of wealth (last 12 months bank statements, salary certificates, business contracts)
Enhanced transaction monitoring on first 6 months
Documented rationale recorded in case file
reporting_obligations: Confirmed sanctions match → STR filed with UAE FIU within 24 hours and customer not onboarded.
Confirmed PEP → recorded in PEP register; quarterly review.
Adverse media — financial crime → recorded in case file; review by senior compliance officer.
